subject: Re: Zephyr vendor form — line itemization and commit exceptions
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <s.jenkins@zephyrai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Zephyr vendor form & line-item billing requirement

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier today. Our procurement team attached the completed preferred vendor form (attached) but flagged a few items that need clarification before we can cut a PO:

- Zephyr requires each API product to appear as a discrete line item on the PO (we can’t accept an aggregated monthly charge without line-item detail).
- We need a mapping from your "per-token" rates to invoice line items so our AP team can reconcile monthly usage to the PO.
- If committed discounts apply, procurement wants the commit tiers and fallback rates clearly documented on the vendor form.

I attached the vendor form — procurement marked where they expect line-item names and example columns for monthly usage reconciliation. Can you confirm whether Redwood can (a) provide an invoice line-item CSV each month showing tokens-by-line and (b) accept a single master PO that references the monthly CSV for reconciliation?

If there are standard templates you prefer for the mapping, please send them along. Procurement is on a tight cycle and would like to finalize before year-end.

Thanks,
Sarah

--
Sarah Jenkins
Senior Procurement Manager
ZephyrAI
procurement@zephyrai.com
Attachment: Zephyr_Vendor_Form.pdf (application/pdf, 412 KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <s.jenkins@zephyrai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Zephyr vendor form & line-item billing requirement

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear note and the form. I attached a quick draft CSV that shows how we can map model-class usage (chat-gen / embeddings / rerank) to invoice line items on a monthly basis.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can provide a monthly invoice CSV that breaks out tokens by line item. We typically include model family, SKU, token buckets (generated + prompt), and net charge per line.
- We can accept a master PO referencing the monthly CSV as the reconciliation artifact, provided the PO references the Redwood master agreement and includes a clause that monthly usage will be reconciled to the CSV.
- For committed tiers: we can expose commit tiers and the fallback per-token rates in an appendix of the vendor form (we'll also provide the calculation examples).

We do need to flag one procurement caveat: our hosted API discounts are usage-based and blended by tier; we generally do not produce per-request invoice entries. The CSV will be sufficient for AP to reconcile but the invoices will reflect the blended rates per line.

I'm looping in Ben and Rishi to confirm the suggested tier mapping and to surface any legal redlines from our side.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Attachment: draft_lineitem_PO.csv (text/csv, 3 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Zephyr vendor form & line-item billing requirement

Grace — thanks for sending. Quick notes from pricing/sales perspective:

- Zephyr's ask for discrete line items is doable, but we should avoid exposing raw per-request granularity. Proposed approach: 3 invoice line items (Chat Gen, Embeddings, Rerank) with monthly CSV that shows token breakout by model SKU. That satisfies AP while keeping invoice succinct.
- Commit tiers: propose monthly committed token buckets (e.g., 0-500M, 500M-2B, 2B+) with blended per-token pricing per bucket. We can translate the committed annual amount into monthly targets on the PO.
- Discount negotiation: if Zephyr wants deeper commit discounts, offer an annual minimum commit (prepay or monthly committed spend). For flexibility, include a capped overage rate and a 30-day lookback for true-ups.

Legal redlines — we'll need to tighten the "billing reconciliation" clause to say: "Redwood will provide a machine-readable invoice CSV within five business days of month-end for AP reconciliation. Disputes to be raised within 60 days." I attached a short redline doc with suggested language.

Recommended next step: Grace, propose the exact wording to Sarah and send a sample monthly CSV for procurement to review. If Zephyr requests PO line-by-line pricing (per model variant), escalate to Rishi for exception approval.

Ben
Principal Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: redlines_to_vendor_terms.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 28 KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:47:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Zephyr vendor form & line-item billing requirement (procurement guidance)

All — procurement POV here. We can accept a master PO referencing a monthly CSV if the following are included on the PO or in an addendum:

1) A clear reference to the master agreement (Redwood MSA) and the HubSpot deal id (please add).
2) A defined cadence for the CSV delivery (e.g., within 5 business days of month-end) and a reconciliation window (we suggest 45 days).
3) Language that states the vendor will provide the CSV in the format agreed and will include token counts split by model family and month.

On exceptions: Zephyr's procurement team may push for line-level unit prices for every SKU — that's operationally heavy for us. We should offer the blended line items + token CSV approach as standard. If they insist on SKU-level unit pricing, we will treat that as a pricing exception and move to Rishi for approval (possible surcharge + implementation lead time).

I'll draft the short addendum language so Grace can drop it into the vendor form. Also confirm that the HubSpot link and DocuSign envelope will be attached to the PO so AP has the reference IDs.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Strategic Partnerships Operations (Internal Procurement Liaison)
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <s.jenkins@zephyrai.com>, Zephyr Procurement <procurement@zephyrai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -0500
Subject: Final: proposed PO/line-item mapping & commit-tier fallback (ZPH-7832)

Hi Sarah — looping back with the firm approach from our side and the items procurement asked for. Apologies for the back-and-forth; wanted to get internal alignment before finalizing.

Summary of the proposal (short):
- Invoicing: Redwood will accept a master PO referencing the Redwood MSA and the HubSpot deal id (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567). Monthly invoices will include three invoice line items: Chat Gen, Embeddings, Rerank.
- Reconciliation CSV: Redwood will provide a machine-readable CSV within 5 business days of month-end that breaks out token counts by model family and month (sample attached). This CSV will be the reconciliation artifact for AP.
- Commit tiers & pricing: We propose monthly commit buckets derived from your requested annual commit (Deal ZPH-7832). Blended per-token prices for each bucket will be listed in an appendix to the vendor form. Fallback overage rates will be explicit.
- Exceptions: If Zephyr requires SKU-level unitization for the PO, that is non-standard and will be handled as a pricing exception (implementation and potential surcharge). Please confirm if you need that and we'll route to Rishi.

Action items for Zephyr:
1) Confirm you can accept a master PO that references the monthly CSV for reconciliation.
2) If acceptable, sign the vendor form with the addendum language (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/zephyr/ZPH-7832) and return the signed form.
3) If you require SKU-level PO line items, let us know and we will scope the exception (possible delay).

I've attached the sample CSV and a redline of suggested vendor-form language for the reconciliation clause. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if procurement wants to walk through the CSV columns.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this before year-end.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Attachment: draft_lineitem_PO.csv (text/csv, 3 KB); redlines_to_vendor_terms.docx (28 KB)
